source.tokens: client/src/index.css (:root and [data-theme='dark'] as RGB triplets; .paper and @media print pin the paper palette)

themes.paper: .paper on screen and @media print; day values with a white canvas, whatever the screen theme
themes.textSize: html[data-textsize='large'] body { zoom: 1.15 }; html[data-textsize='larger'] body { zoom: 1.3 }

extensions.tonalRampSource: Ramps are assembled from the project's own day, night and paper values for that hue, ordered dark to light. Where a hue has fewer than eight shipped values the gaps are interpolated in the same hue; those interpolated steps are not tokens and are not used in the build.

tintWash.purpose: Opacity of the tint behind a chip icon (--t-wash).

display.purpose: The facility name on the cover band (28px; 24px on a phone) and the product name on the sign-in cover (30px to 36px).

clock.purpose: Local time on the cover band. One clock on the board.

headline.purpose: The recorded figure in a metric cell; a unit beside it is 14px bold ink-3; an unrecorded value is an em dash in ink-3.

title.purpose: A sheet's printed head. Dialog and toast titles are 14px/600; page-level headings inside sheets 16px/700; all headings carry -0.012em by default.

body.purpose: Base text at 14px; table cells at 13px in ink-2.

body-small.purpose: 12px detail lines under a title, notice bodies, list-row descriptions. The most used size in the build.

caption.purpose: The text-2xs step: metadata, footnotes, the spine's status list, the explanation under the cover.

control.purpose: Buttons and index tabs. btn-sm 12px, btn-lg 14px.

label.purpose: Over a column or a figure only: table heads 0.06em, metric labels 0.07em, stamps 0.08em, cover readings 0.12em, pills 0.04em. Never above a sentence heading.

section.purpose: A heading on the ruled ground between sheets, with an optional caption at the baseline.

form-label.purpose: Above a field, sentence case, ink-2. A form is filled in, not printed.

fontFeatures.numerals: tabular-nums lining-nums on body, .metric-value, .paper and every .num cell; Archivo carries tnum and equal digit widths were measured.

shadows.name: panel
shadows.purpose: Every sheet at rest. Navy-tinted so it reads as paper on blue.

shadows.name: raised
shadows.purpose: Defined for a sheet that must sit above its neighbours; unused on the shipped board.

shadows.name: overlay
shadows.purpose: Menus, dialogs, toasts, the navigation drawer, the sign-in sheet.

shadows.name: cover
shadows.purpose: The cover band, under a 7% white sheen from the top edge fading by 60%.

shadows.name: label
shadows.purpose: The white label carrying the Lloyds Metals mark on a blue surface.

shadows.name: open-tab
shadows.purpose: The open section on the spine, cut in the paper colour.

shadows.name: scrim
shadows.purpose: Under dialogs. Navy, not black, so the night shift is not flashed.

motion.name: page-turn
motion.value: 360ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); opacity 0 to 1, translateY(10px) to none
motion.purpose: The one authored moment: the new section turns in when an index tab is chosen. Applied to the section wrapper keyed on the section id, never per element.

motion.name: rise
motion.value: 220ms ease-out; opacity 0 to 1, translateY(6px) to none
motion.purpose: .enter, kept only for the dialog and the toast.

motion.name: metric-underline
motion.value: transform 180ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); scaleX(0) to scaleX(1) from the left
motion.purpose: The 3px ink rule under a pressable metric cell on hover.

motion.name: bar
motion.purpose: A comparison bar filling to its measured value.

motion.name: drawer
motion.purpose: The spine sliding in as a drawer below 1024px.

motion.name: shimmer
motion.purpose: Skeleton rows while data loads; a state, not an authored moment.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) removes every animation and transition above

breakpoints.name: sm
breakpoints.note: Metric strips go from 2 to 3 columns; cover title from 24px to 28px; toast anchors bottom-right.

breakpoints.name: md
breakpoints.note: Page padding 16px to 24px; theme control shows its label.

breakpoints.name: lg
breakpoints.note: Spine becomes a persistent 256px column; top bar shows facility name and search; metric strips reach their full column count; sign-in becomes two columns with the cover on the left.

breakpoints.name: xl
breakpoints.note: Top-bar clock, Check in label and Dispense button appear; overview boards go two-up.

contrast.floor: 4.5:1 for all text on both sheets

deliberateDetectorFindings.why: The bound edge of the register on the sign-in cover. Permitted only there; never on a card, list row, callout or alert.
The ink rule that says a figure column is pressable. Hover-only, drawn from the left; not a resting border.

assets.mark: client/public/lloyds_metals_logo.png, the official Lloyds Metals mark (black gear badge, red block). Never recoloured; always on a white .cover-label on blue.
assets.favicon: Inline SVG heartbeat line stroked in #0E4ED6 (client/index.html).

narrative.overview:
The interface is the health-centre register book, open at today's page. A deep navy cloth spine down the left carries the sections; the facility's name sits on a cobalt cover band at the head of the page; the working surface is ice-blue ledger paper ruled at a fixed pitch, on which white sheets lie with feint blue rules, printed small-cap column heads, and figures set large in tabular numerals so a column adds up by eye. Status is stamped, not glowing: a bordered word in the ink of the surface it sits on. It refuses the analytics dashboard of floating KPI cards on grey.

One rule governs colour. Blue is the material of the book: every structural element, tint and heading is a shade of it. Red, amber and green are reserved for clinical and operational state, so a coloured mark on this screen always means someone should act. The night sheet is the same register as a carbon copy: light ink on carbon-blue paper for a ward at three in the morning, not a second design.

It is an Operate surface for staff who did not grow up with software, read on a ten-year-old laptop under a bright window and on a tablet at the foot of a bed. Density is high but ruled; every figure has a printed head above it and one line of context beneath it; every action is a labelled button. The confirmed anti-references are the previous red-branded shell, KPI cards floating on grey, decorative gradients and glass, and any colour used for identity on a clinical figure.
keyCharacteristics: Ledger blue throughout: navy spine, cobalt cover, ice paper, white sheets, blue ink.
Red, amber and green are state words, never decoration; the text carries the meaning.
Ruled, not floated: figures live in one strip separated by hairline rules, sheets lie flat.
Printed column heads (10.5px, bold, tracked, uppercase, deep blue) over figures and columns only.
Archivo Variable, self-hosted, with tabular lining numerals everywhere by default.
Two sheets for two rooms: the day sheet at the counter, the carbon copy on the ward.
One authored motion, the page turning when a section tab is chosen.
4px corners; index tabs rounded on top; the open spine tab rounded on its page edge.

rules.name: The Blue Ink Rule
rules.body: Everything structural is a shade of the book's blue: paper, rules, heads, tints, spine, cover. Red, amber and green appear only as critical, warn and ok, and only when the record holds that state. An element in one of those hues with no state behind it is a defect.

rules.name: The Carbon Copy Rule
rules.body: Night is the same register printed through carbon paper. Tokens are redefined; components are not. Anything drawn differently at night (the cover's top rule, the spine's edge rule, the open tab's wash) exists only because the carbon ground removed a contrast the day sheet had.

rules.name: The White Label Rule
rules.body: The Lloyds Metals mark (black gear badge, red block) is the company's official mark and is never recoloured, inverted or tinted. On any blue surface it sits on a white label (cover-label) with its own hairline shadow. Its red is the only red on screen that is not a state.

rules.name: The Lifted State Rule
rules.body: A state word on navy or cobalt uses on-blue-ok or on-blue-warn, never the paper-sheet ok or warn, which would fall below 4.5:1 on blue.

rules.name: The Column Head Rule
rules.body: A small-cap tracked head is printed over a figure, a column or a section of the ruled ground. It is never placed above a sentence heading as an eyebrow or kicker; a heading carries its own weight.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Numerals are tabular and lining everywhere, set once on body and again on .metric-value, .paper and every .num cell. A figure is always compared against the one above it.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Archivo Variable carries every role. No second face, no system display face, no monospace as a costume. Hierarchy is weight (400, 600, 700, 800) and size.

rules.name: The Ruled Strip Rule
rules.body: Related figures share one sheet separated by hairline rules. A row of individually bordered, shadowed cards is the rejected world.

rules.name: The Measure Rule
rules.body: Explanatory prose stops at 48rem; a cell's context line at its cell, truncated with a title attribute; a list row's detail at 28rem.

rules.name: The Flat Sheet Rule
rules.body: A sheet gets the panel shadow and nothing more. Only an element that is not part of the page (menu, dialog, toast, drawer) gets the overlay shadow. Hover is a tone change, never a lift.

rules.name: The Stamped Word Rule
rules.body: A state is a word with a border, in the ink of its hue. A colour-only dot or bar never carries a state on its own; the dot on the cover strip sits beside its sentence.

rules.name: The Unrecorded Dash Rule
rules.body: A value the database does not hold prints an em dash in ink-3 with the title "Not recorded". A metric never counts up from zero and never shows a plausible default.

dos: Do build every structural element from the blue tokens: canvas, surface, subtle, the three rules, the three inks, brand, brand-deep, brand-wash, spine.
Do write a colour once through its token so it renders on both sheets; the night values are the same names redefined under [data-theme='dark'].
Do put related figures in one MetricStrip with gap-px on bg-line-soft, with a printed head above each figure and one context line beneath.
Do print heads in label style (10.5px, 700, 0.06em to 0.08em, uppercase, brand-deep) over columns, figures and sections only.
Do set the mark on a white cover-label on any blue surface and leave its red and black alone.
Do use on-blue-ok and on-blue-warn for a state word on navy or cobalt.
Do keep the day palette for anything printed: .paper pins it on screen and the print engine pins it for the printer.
Do give every control a name that is its action ("Check in a patient", "Clear samples and go live", "Admit patient"), and every failure a sentence naming the problem and the way out.
Do cap prose at 48rem and keep a figure's context to one truncated line.
Do honour prefers-reduced-motion for any new motion, and keep the page turn the only authored moment on the board.
donts: Don't use red, amber or green for identity, emphasis, a department, a chart series or decoration. They are critical, warn and ok, and they report a recorded state.
Don't float figures in individually bordered or shadowed cards, and don't put an icon chip in a metric cell.
Don't put a tracked uppercase label above a heading. Heads go over figures and columns; headings speak for themselves.
Don't render the cover band at night as a cobalt slab; it is the brand wash with a 3px cobalt top rule.
Don't add a ring, halo, glow, zero-offset shadow, gradient text, glass or blur. Depth is the ruling and the hairline panel shadow.

Don't put a coloured border-left or border-right wider than 1px on a card, list row, callout or alert. The 10px navy bound edge on .cover-page and the 3px hover-only rule on a metric cell are the two deliberate exceptions and stay where they are.
Don't load a font, icon or asset from a CDN or any remote URL; the clinic has no internet.
Don't show a plausible default, a simulated reading or a placeholder figure; print the dash.
Don't add a second typeface, a monospace costume or a system display face; hierarchy is Archivo's weight and size.
Don't add a second clock to the board or a second authored motion to the page.
